scope: Icarus four-state execution at the public AXI boundary. Unwritten RAM and non-reset cache data remain X; control/address and active write-byte unknowns are rejected. Fixed-reset mapped CPU uses a two-instruction Flash trampoline to the program at0x80000000. Sparse model covers128MiB addresses with8MiB resident pages, and actual page usage is recorded. Fast-memory runs remove artificial bus wait cycles while preserving the full program, four-state memory, and every checker. Zero-delay functional cell simulation, no SDF/timing-signoff claim.
